Good work needs space. This presentation shows three simple ways to reduce interruptions. Protect your attention and make room for better ideas. Begin by choosing a single priority for the morning. Do AM, turn off notifications and close the applications you do not need. Tell your colleagues when you will be available again. After a focus session, take a short break away from the screen. These changes do not require a perfect schedule. Try one small experiment this week. Observe what helps and adjust your routine. The goal is to create enough quiet time to think clearly and finish work that matters.
